off.title: Evalezy is turned off
off.body: Your institute has turned off Evalezy. An admin can turn it on in Settings → Assessment → Evalezy app.

home.title: Check answer copies
home.subtitle: Pick the assessment, scan or upload the copies, and the AI checks them.
home.emptyHint: Assessments that are checked by hand show up here once they are published.

assessment.noPaper: This assessment has no questions yet, so copies can't be checked. Add the question paper in the dashboard first.
assessment.scanHint: Page by page; tap "Next student" between copies
assessment.uploadHint: Each PDF is one copy. Photos picked together make one copy.
assessment.noInput: Adding copies is turned off for your institute.
assessment.insufficient: Not enough credits for these copies. Remove some copies or add credits.

scanner.noCamera: The live camera isn't available here. Take each page with your camera app instead.
scanner.hint: Hold the page flat and fill the frame
scanner.pageFailed: That page couldn't be saved. Take it again.

tray.failed: Couldn't send. It stays here so you can try again.

errors.tooMany: You can send up to {{max}} copies at a time.
errors.notSupported: {{name}} isn't a PDF or a photo.
errors.nothingUploaded: No copy could be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.startFailed: Couldn't start the check. Try again.

toasts.started_one: Checking 1 copy. You can leave this page; we'll email you when it's done.
toasts.started_other: Checking {{count}} copies. You can leave this page; we'll email you when they're done.
